text:
jamie_support: heads-up — AcmeCorp reporting wide SSO failures after their IdP rotated an ephemeral signing cert at ~09:12 UTC. Users see 401 on callback. customer says some sessions fail immediately, others succeed then 401 on next action.

maria_enginfra: can you paste the SP logs (AssertionConsumerService) and the IdP metadata URL? first guess is metadata watcher didn't pick up new cert or proxy cached old metadata.

jamie_support: metadata URL: https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml  — we pulled logs: `Assertion validation failed: Signature verification failed: key not found for digest`

ben_sre: @jamie_support do we have the raw SAML Response from a failing attempt? Also did they front with any CDN/proxy that could be serving cached metadata? :thinking_face:

jamie_support: yes attached SAML (sanitized). Quick snippet from SP error log: `2026-03-11T09:18:04Z ERROR saml: signature verification failed: expected cert thumbprint 8A:3C:... got none`

jamie_support: we fetched metadata and saw 200 but with long cache headers: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400` and an ETag. metadata-watchdog-bot: polling status shows last fetch 2026-03-11T09:00:01Z, next scheduled 10:00:01Z.

metadata-watchdog-bot: metadata fetch: 200 OK, ETag "\"abc123\"", fetched_cert_thumbprints: ["4F:EE:..."], local_store_timestamp: 2026-03-11T09:00:01Z

maria_enginfra: that lines up — IdP rotated at 09:12 but our watcher hadn't polled yet. If the proxy/CDN cached the old metadata, SPs behind that proxy will keep using old key info so signature fails. Two paths: 1) purge cached metadata on edge, or 2) force a metadata refresh on SP (hot reload).

aline_prodsec: couple notes — ephemeral signing certs are allowed but IdP must maintain overlapping signing keys in metadata (old + new) for a short handover window. Ask Acme to include the previous KeyDescriptor while they rotate, or set low cache TTL. Also confirm no SAML Response was re-signed by an intermediate CA only present in the IdP but missing from our chain verification.

jamie_support: customer says they rotated and removed the old key immediately. They also use an on-path proxy that rewrites Host header and has its own caching layer. customer provided headers when fetching metadata: `Via: 1.1 proxy-edge`, `X-Cache: HIT`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400`

ben_sre: reproduce steps for us:
```
# fetch metadata via their proxy (simulate)
curl -i -H "Host: idp.acme.example" https://proxy-edge-acme.example/fetch/metadata.xml
# observe headers and cert thumbprints
```

ben_sre: temporary mitigation we can ask Acme to do immediately:
- purge CDN/proxy cache for metadata.xml
- re-add prior signing KeyDescriptor to metadata so existing tokens validate for a short window
- or sign assertions with new key but keep old key present for 24h

omar_supportlead: escalation checklist — I've opened a support ticket with priority high. Please collect: IdP metadata URL, example failing SAML Response, SP logs, exact timestamps of IdP rotation, and proxy vendor + cache TTLs. I'll coordinate with account exec for urgency.

jamie_support: collected and added to ticket #SUP-11872. Customer agrees to purge edge cache and re-add old KeyDescriptor for now. They asked if we can temporarily accept either cert on our end without waiting for metadata poll.

maria_enginfra: we can support a manual metadata reload for their Dedicated/Private SPs: `POST /admin/metadata/reload?force=true` (internal only). For hosted, we'd need to ensure watcher picks up — we can also trigger an immediate fetch via ops. I'll trigger now for the customer tenant.

metadata-watchdog-bot: triggered immediate fetch for tenant acme-corp at 2026-03-11T09:25:12Z — result: 200 OK, new ETag "\"def456\"", cert_thumbprints: ["8A:3C:..."] . Local store updated.

ben_sre: after forced reload I recommend they attempt login again and capture SAML Response. Also check for mixed traffic — some requests may hit old edge nodes still holding cached metadata; their purge should be verified by `X-Cache: MISS` on next fetch.

jamie_support: update from customer 09:34 UTC — most users can log in now, a small subset still 401ing. They cleared cache and we forced reload. They see `X-Cache: MISS` now. One customer app still fails intermittently.

aline_prodsec: that intermittent case could be long-lived sessions signed with the removed key that then call an SP endpoint that enforces re-validation. Confirm whether the SP validates assertion signature on every request or only at login. If the latter, some requests shouldn't fail.

ben_sre: next steps:
- ask customer to re-try failing user with browser devtools open to capture full request/response
- collect the failing SAMLResponse base64 if possible
- ensure no load balancer affinity to an old-edge pool that still cached metadata

jamie_support: customer will provide trace and failing SAMLResponse shortly. For now workaround documented and ops forced refresh. Omar — want me to escalate to eng-infra if traces show proxy CDN still serving old copy?

omar_supportlead: yes escalate if we still see any HITs on edge or signature mismatches after they confirm purge. PRD risk low now but keep ticket open until full verification. :white_check_mark:

maria_enginfra: internal action item created: INF-SSO-462 — add on-demand metadata reload API for hosted customers and lower default max-age to 300s for metadata fetches. I'll add a note to rollout plan.

jamie_support: thanks team, will post customer traces when received. Closing interim updates here.

# end of thread
